components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary arena action for room creation and panic hide.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 3px); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #d91642); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #d91642); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #b81137); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #b81137); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d91642); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-mode-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--bg-rail, #151921); padding: 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); } .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); background: var(--bg-elevated, #1c222d); } .ds-nav-tab.is-active { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); background: var(--bg-elevated, #1c222d); border-color: var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d91642); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-room-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 6px 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 3px); background: var(--bg-void, #101216); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live, #22c55e); } .ds-mono-val { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mono-muted { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); } .ds-room-divider { width: 1px; height: 12px; background: var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); } .ds-copy-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #262c38); background: var(--bg-elevated, #1c222d); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-copy-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #242b38); } .ds-copy-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d91642); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-clock-stack { width: 100%; max-width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #262c38); background: var(--bg-rail, #151921); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); } .ds-clock-specimen { padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #262c38); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-clock-specimen:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-clock-specimen.is-active { background: var(--bg-elevated, #1c222d); } .ds-clock-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-player-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); } .ds-turn-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); } .ds-clock-specimen.is-active .ds-turn-tag { color: var(--accent-ink, #ff4d73); } .ds-clock-axis { position: relative; height: 1px; background: var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); margin: 2px 0; } .ds-clock-specimen.is-active .ds-clock-axis { background: rgba(217, 22, 66, 0.55); } .ds-clock-axis-dot { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-clock-specimen.is-active .ds-clock-axis-dot { left: calc(100% - 5px); background: var(--accent-ink, #ff4d73); } .ds-clock-digits { font-size: 46px; line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-variation-settings: 'wght' 520; color: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); } .ds-clock-specimen.is-active .ds-clock-digits { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); font-variation-settings: 'wght' 780; }

components.css: .ds-custom-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 100%; max-width: 280px; } .ds-preset-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 2px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-preset-btn { padding: 8px 6px; border: 0; background: var(--bg-void, #101216); color: var(--ink-muted, #94a3b8); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preset-btn:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); background: var(--bg-rail, #151921); } .ds-preset-btn.is-selected { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(217, 22, 66, 0.22); } .ds-op-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-op-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 3px); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #343d4d); background: var(--bg-void, #101216); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f6); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-op-cell:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated, #1c222d); } .ds-op-cell.is-armed { border-color: var(--accent, #d91642); background: rgba(217, 22, 66, 0.14); } .ds-preset-btn:focus-visible, .ds-op-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d91642); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
Vesper64 treats a competitive online chessboard like a calibrated Swiss foundry specimen rendered onto matte dark slate. Rather than surrounding the 64 squares with noisy chess-portal sidebars, drop shadows, or novelty gag chrome, every interface surface relies on crisp tonal steps (`#101216` through `#242b38`), `1px` structural hairlines, and oversized variable-weight countdown clocks whose stroke weight shifts live with turn ownership and low-time urgency.

Cover credibility is the aesthetic's first duty: guests and invited friends experience a focused, tournament-grade match room with zero onboarding friction and zero trace of concealed tooling. Authorized operator accounts unlock a structurally native right-hand drawer (`Operator Console`) that shares the exact same `1px`-ruled dark slate grammar, keeping tactical manipulation silent until summoned by hotkey or brand gesture.
keyCharacteristics: Matte dark-slate tonal layering (`#101216` void ground, `#151921` rails, `#1c222d` active specimens) with zero drop shadows across the entire application.
Variable-weight display countdown specimens in self-hosted `Figtree` shifting smoothly across `'wght' 520` (standby), `'wght' 780` (active turn), and `'wght' 880` (`<20s` urgency).
Hairline-ruled `1px` structural grid framing a central `1:1` alabaster-and-slate chessboard (`#e5e7ec` / `#343c4a`) with external `22px` coordinate rails.
Single foundry crimson accent (`#d91642`) reserved strictly for primary room creation, active turn telemetry, focus rings, capture targets, and armed operator states.
Self-hosted variable typography (`Figtree` `300–900` and `JetBrains Mono` `400–700`) with tabular numerals across clocks, algebraic move ledgers, and room codes.

rules.name: The Crimson Signal Rule
rules.body: `Foundry Crimson` (`#d91642`) and `Crimson Signal` (`#ff4d73`) are strictly reserved for active turn ownership, primary commitment actions, focus outlines, check/capture pressure, and armed operator states; standby surfaces and passive chrome remain strictly achromatic slate.

rules.name: The Dual-Ink Piece Contrast Rule
rules.body: Light and dark SVG chess pieces never rely on bare monochrome silhouettes alone: dark pieces layer `#11151d` fills with `#657289` outer strokes and `#8592a8` interior lines so pieces remain crisp over `#343c4a` dark squares.

rules.name: The Variable Axis Turn Rule
rules.body: Turn state on clocks is communicated through `Figtree`'s live `wght` variable axis (`'wght' 520` standby → `'wght' 780` active → `'wght' 880` urgent) paired with `tabular-nums`, preventing digit jitter during tenth-of-a-second countdown ticks.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric readout that updates during play—clocks, ply counters, move pairs, material advantage (`+3`), and room codes—uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns never shift horizontally mid-match.

rules.name: The Fixed Board Registration Rule
rules.body: Switching between pre-game lobby setup, live friend match, bot play, or an open operator drawer never unmounts or shifts the primary chessboard column structure unnecessarily; center stage remains anchored on the `1:1` coordinate-framed board.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Architecture Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast ambient or drop shadows; interactive elevation is communicated strictly through surface-step luminance (`#151921` → `#1c222d` → `#242b38`) and `1px` hairline contrast.

rules.name: The Chamfered Precision Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome uses tight `2px` (`--radius-sm`) or `3px` (`--radius-md`) corners while board squares remain `0px`; `50%` circles are reserved solely for status dots, legal-move indicators, capture rings, and spinners.

rules.name: The Concealed Parity Rule
rules.body: The `Operator Console` drawer shares the exact same slate palette, `1px` borders, `segmented-tabs`, and `2px`/`3px` radii as the public arena so authorized operators experience zero visual seam—while unauthorized clients never render its DOM or styles.

dos: **Do** keep `1px` structural hairlines (`#262c38` / `#343d4d`) and stepped dark-slate tonal layers (`#101216` → `#151921` → `#1c222d`) as the sole depth mechanism.
**Do** modulate clock urgency through `Figtree`'s variable `wght` axis (`520` → `780` → `880`) paired with `tabular-nums` and the sliding `.clock-axis-dot`.
**Do** reserve `Foundry Crimson` (`#d91642`) and `Crimson Signal` (`#ff4d73`) strictly for primary CTAs, active turn signals, focus rings, capture rings, and armed operator states.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` across all transitions, piece nudges, and spinner animations (`0.01ms`).
**Do** keep every public-facing lobby, clock, and board surface indistinguishable from a serious tournament chess studio so zero troll UI leaks to guests.
donts: **Don't** introduce `box-shadow`, glass blur, or bright neon gradients onto panels, modals, or buttons.
**Don't** round chessboard squares (`0px`) or inflate UI chrome radii past `3px` (`--radius-md`), reserving `50%` circles solely for dots, capture rings, and spinners.
**Don't** replace self-hosted variable `Figtree` or `JetBrains Mono` with system display faces, or omit `tabular-nums` on clocks, move ledgers, and ply counters.
**Don't** render any `Operator Console` controls, troll hints, or `Arbiter` arrows into the DOM when `canTroll` is false.
**Don't** hardcode raw color drift values (such as legacy `#e11d48` alpha overlays) when extending new board or alert states; reference `:root` `--accent` tokens consistently.
